memory_bumble_beginning.title: The Beginning
lines: And then, somehow, our paths crossed.
We started talking. At first, I didn't think much of it.
But one conversation turned into another... and another.
There was something about the way she talked — I kept smiling at my phone like an idiot.
Days passed, and somehow I still wanted more.
I didn't just want to talk to her anymore. I wanted to know what it felt like to be around her.
So I asked if we could meet.

memory_uniqlo_first_meeting.title: Uniqlo
lines: Early September. A Sunday night.
The weather was just right. Not hot, no rain. The kind of night that makes you feel like something good is coming.
Our first date. Uniqlo, of all places.
I needed new pants. Not the most romantic start, I know.
And then you walked in.
Deep indigo denim jacket. A brown tee. Black pants.
You looked effortless. Like you weren't even trying, and that was the whole point.
You looked at me, then at the racks, and just knew.
Khaki chinos. You handed them to me like it was obvious.
And you were right. Of course you were right.
I stood there realizing something: you could see a version of me I'd never managed to see myself.
Two years later, you still can.
We rode off together. You behind me on the black BeAT, arms around me.
I didn't know it that night.
But I was never going to ride alone again.

memory_marugame_first_meal.title: Marugame Udon
lines: After Uniqlo, we were hungry. Marugame Udon.
Two bowls of niku udon. Cups of ocha, steam rising between us.
Nothing fancy. But somewhere between the first bite and the last, I stopped being nervous.
The conversation didn't run out. It never ran out.
I remember thinking. I could do this again. And again.

memory_cinema_lembayung.title: Lembayung
lines: Then, the cinema. Our first movie together. Lembayung.
Horror. And I found out we both love it. The dread, the dark, the jump scares.
One small difference, though.
You sit there calm. Barely flinch. Watch the scariest parts dead in the eye.
And me? Jacket up over my face, peeking through a gap, whispering is it over, is it over.
You just laugh at me. Every time.
Two horror lovers. One brave, one hiding behind a jacket.
I wouldn't trade it.

memory_horror_nights.title: The Horror Nights
lines: After Lembayung, we couldn't stop.
Every horror movie we could find, we found them together.
Pengepungan Bukit Duri. Final Destination Bloodlines. 28 Years Later. The Housemaid. Weapons. The Mummy. Black Phone 2. Hokum. Obsession. Backrooms.
And Weapons. That's the one that got me the worst.
Jacket all the way up. I think I watched half of it through a gap in the sleeve.
You barely blinked.
You, calm as ever. Me, hiding. Every single time.
Side by side for all of them.

memory_macaroni_schotel.title: Macaroni Schotel
lines: One day, you cooked for me.
Macaroni schotel. The first thing you ever made me.
I still remember the first bite. That this came from your hands, for me.
I'd always hoped for someone who could make a place feel like home.
Turns out you were already doing it.

memory_food_explorer.title: The Food We Chased
lines: Turns out we both loved the same thing: chasing good food.
Viral places, hidden gems, tiny hawker stalls. If it was good, we found it.
Nasi Uduk Kebon Kacang. Belah Duren. Taichan Siram. Yakudo Ramen. Kanaka. Sushi Matsuki. Obihiro. Kwetiaw Asap Medan. Nogura. Andi Soto. Sinar Minang Baru.
Every weekend, somewhere new. Or somewhere old that we loved too much to leave alone.
Me in front, you behind me, the whole city smelling like something delicious.

memory_berselesa.title: Berselesa
lines: There was one place. Berselesa. A little coffee shop that happened to make food we loved.
Nasi goreng and an americano. Every time, the same order.
We always went at night. Always up on the second floor.
No smoke up there, the AC was good, and it was quiet. Just us.
We went back again and again.
It's closed now. Permanently. We can't go anymore.
Some places don't get to stay.
But we did. We got to stay.

memory_sushi_kintaro.title: Kintaro
lines: Funny story. One night we were too late for Obihiro. They were closing.
So we ended up at a sushi place instead. Somewhere I'd never have chosen.
Because I always said I didn't like sushi.
Then I dared myself. A place nearby. Kintaro.
Chuka idako. Sashimi. All of it.
I found out I didn't hate sushi at all. I just hadn't tried it with you.
You keep doing that. Opening doors in me I didn't know were closed.

memory_tuku_after_work.title: Tuku After Work
lines: After work, we had a place. Tuku. Kopi susu tetangga, every time.
First time I tried it, I couldn't drink it without sugar. Too much for me.
You told me it's better without. No sugar. Trust you.
You were right. Of course you were right. It is better without.
But I felt like I was losing money buying it plain.
So now? I get the sugar on the side. Every time.
I never use it. It just sits there.
You laugh at me. I don't care. It's my sugar I'm not using.

memory_cat_cemplung.title: Cemplung
lines: You have four cats. Bubu. Mumu. Sisil. Cemplung.
The first time I came over, they scattered. Bolted the second I walked in.
Cemplung was the first one who stopped running away from me.
I thought maybe I'd finally earned his trust.
Later I learned he may have been faking a sore leg for attention, which is also very Cemplung.

memory_cat_mumu.title: Mumu
lines: After Cemplung, Mumu started staying nearby too.
The house felt a little less like I was a suspicious guest.
One cat trusting me made the next small step feel possible.

memory_cat_sisil.title: Sisil
lines: Then Sisil stopped running away.
Not all at once, not dramatically. Just a little closer than before.
Enough to make me feel like I was slowly becoming part of your world.

memory_cat_bubu.title: Bubu
lines: Bubu was last, of course.
Cute, moody, and she's scratched me twice, so her approval had conditions.
When even Bubu stopped running away, it felt like the whole family had finally let me in.
Four cats decided I belong here.
And somewhere along the way, so did I.

memory_september.title: September
lines: Two years.
Uniqlo to here. A stranger's cats to a home. Every meal, every movie, every ride on the BeAT.
It started on a September night. The weather just right. Something good coming.
And here we are. September again.
There's a road ahead I can't see the end of.
But I know who's on the back of my bike.
Arms around me. Like always.
I'm not done walking with you.
Not even close.
